The enzymes glycogen synthetase and glycogen phosphorylase are both involved in the formation and breakdown of glycogen in the liver.
Fig. 5.2 shows the activity of the two enzymes in the liver after consumption of a glucose meal.
{{figure:figure_5_2.png}}
Describe and suggest an explanation for the changes in the activity of the enzymes glycogen synthetase and glycogen phosphorylase.
